metadata.title: The Links--Gould polynomial of an alternating link is alternating
metadata.abstract: Building on work of Kauffman--Saleur and earlier work of the second author, we derive a determinant formula for the Links--Gould polynomial of links. As an application, we prove a 20-year-old conjecture of Ishii: for any alternating link, the Links--Gould invariant is an alternating polynomial.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 交错链环 Links–Gould 多项式的交错性
analysis.workSummary: 导出链环 Links–Gould 多项式的行列式公式，并据此宣称证明 Ishii 的二十年前猜想：任意交错链环的 Links–Gould 不变量为交错多项式。
analysis.breakthrough: 以显式计算公式解决交错链环对应的多项式交错性问题。
analysis.limitations: 交错性结论限定交错链环，不能推广到一般链环。
analysis.priorityReason: 量子链环不变量的长期猜想有可计算公式支撑
